mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers investor caution, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies show upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 indicates robust supply-side growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 105.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected drop in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals policy divergence from expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops below 4.5% in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative during tightening periods despite FEDFUNDS below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and labor market activity (PAYEMS) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies show upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the CPIAUCSL index above 240 signals accelerating inflation, prompting investors to sell equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive when CPIAUCSL crosses above 240.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies show upward momentum in a late-cycle expansion.
